newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia internal coffee price unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Colombia internal coffee price unchanged.

text.p: Colombia's internal coffee price remained unchanged Friday at 317,000 pesos per 125-kg load, the National Coffee Growers' Federation said.
A federation spokesman said the price was calculated on the basis of an average price of $2.09 in international markets over the last week.
Colombia's internal coffee price is set weekly on a sliding scale pegged to average international prices -- a system introduced in late January to allow coffee growers benefit from price variations.
